AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a tacking stitch? (1 mark)
   A. A temporary stitch that holds cloth in place
   B. A type of cloth
   C. A cutting tool
   D. A permanent decorative stitch

2. Why should food be cut into small pieces before cooking? (1 mark)
   A. They burn the pot
   B. Small pieces cook faster and use less fuel
   C. They take longer to cook
   D. They need more water

3. What is one way to choose foods for a balanced meal? (1 mark)
   A. Pick only your favourite food
   B. Pick one or more foods from each group
   C. Pick only cheap food
   D. Pick only sweet food

4. Which is a way of reducing waste? (1 mark)
   A. Buy more packages
   B. Reuse containers
   C. Throw things away quickly
   D. Burn tins

5. What size square did we cut for the handkerchief? (1 mark)
   A. 2 cm by 2 cm
   B. 5 m by 5 m
   C. 1 m by 1 m
   D. 25 cm by 25 cm

6. What is compost manure? (1 mark)
   A. Fresh soil from a river bank
   B. A dark crumbly material made when plant and animal wastes rot
   C. A kind of animal feed
   D. Fertiliser made in a factory

7. Which of these meals is balanced? (1 mark)
   A. Chips only
   B. Tea and bread only
   C. Soda and sweets
   D. Ugali, beans and sukuma wiki

8. Which sign shows a purple passion fruit is ripe? (1 mark)
   A. Bright green skin
   B. Hard green skin
   C. Deep purple skin that begins to wrinkle
   D. A white flower

9. Why should vegetables be boiled for a short time only? (1 mark)
   A. It saves nothing
   B. Long boiling destroys some vitamins
   C. Short boiling makes them poisonous
   D. Long boiling makes them colder

10. What is a hem? (1 mark)
   A. A hole
   B. A button
   C. A needle
   D. A folded and stitched edge of cloth

11. Why does a scarecrow need a hat and clothes? (1 mark)
   A. To keep warm
   B. To store food
   C. To look like a person and frighten animals
   D. To dry the crops

12. Which of these animal foods is rich in protein? (1 mark)
   A. Bread
   B. Fish
   C. Banana
   D. Cassava

13. Which food is bad for teeth if eaten too often? (1 mark)
   A. Eggs
   B. Water
   C. Sweets
   D. Vegetables

14. What is the young one of a hen called? (1 mark)
   A. Lamb
   B. Kid
   C. Chick
   D. Calf

15. What should the scarecrow pole be like? (1 mark)
   A. Made of glass
   B. Firmly fixed in the ground so it does not fall
   C. Very short
   D. Loose so it can fall over

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What is personal protective equipment (PPE)? (2 marks)

17. State two ways of making drinking water safe. (2 marks)

18. Explain how PPE should be stored and why. (4 marks)

19. Give three reasons why fruits are important. (3 marks)

20. Describe how to clean canvas shoes. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A temporary stitch that holds cloth in place
   Tacking is removed later.

2. B — Small pieces cook faster and use less fuel
   Small pieces heat through quickly.

3. B — Pick one or more foods from each group
   A balanced meal includes all three groups.

4. B — Reuse containers
   Reuse cuts down rubbish.

5. D — 25 cm by 25 cm
   A small handkerchief is easy to make.

6. B — A dark crumbly material made when plant and animal wastes rot
   Compost is organic manure made from rotted wastes.

7. D — Ugali, beans and sukuma wiki
   It includes all three groups.

8. C — Deep purple skin that begins to wrinkle
   Purple types change colour when ripe.

9. B — Long boiling destroys some vitamins
   Vitamins are lost with too much cooking.

10. D — A folded and stitched edge of cloth
   A hem stops edges fraying.

11. C — To look like a person and frighten animals
   Animals fear people, so a figure like a person scares them.

12. B — Fish
   Fish is a protein food.

13. C — Sweets
   Sugar helps decay.

14. C — Chick
   A chick is a young chicken.

15. B — Firmly fixed in the ground so it does not fall
   A loose pole falls in the wind.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Clothing and gear worn to protect the body from dirt, injury, dust and germs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for clothing or gear, 1 mark for protection.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Boil and cool it covered; use a filter or treatment tablets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Clean and dry, in a cupboard, rack or clean box, so it does not grow mould or spread germs, and labelled so it is used by the owner.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for storing, 2 marks for reasons.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins, they give fibre and water, and they can be sold for money.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Remove laces; brush off loose dirt; scrub gently with soapy water; rinse; stuff with paper; dry in the shade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.
